name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private two-track terminus prototype with direct platform binding and explicit crossover.
description: Revision 15 adds UM Twin Terminus (Test) as a new construction. A double front approach branches to two separate single-lane platform tracks, with two crossing root-edge routes sharing an explicit middle junction. Both terminals bind directly to their own single-lane midpoint; the ambiguous double approach is not a terminal. Uses existing proven mixed-mode profiles and game assets. The new switch geometry, native junction rendering, platform reachability, line choices, reversal at these new platforms and crossing safety are not yet engine-tested. Begin with one new station on a copy of the validated save and ten seconds of read-only diagnostics. Existing working stations, profiles and routes are not changed. No overlapping reverse edges or automatic vehicle commands. One vehicle only after topology is assessed.
